clinical_intent: A 65-year-old man named James has a T3N0M0 anal canal squamous cell carcinoma. He has completed 54 Gy of concurrent chemoradiation with mitomycin C and 5-FU. The post-treatment MRI shows a good partial response with a 1.5 cm residual abnormality. The tumor board is discussing whether to recommend observation, completion surgery, or brachytherapy boost. Analyze the options and provide a recommendation.
